t.E440.agn: In 2017 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern for the general population.
t.E440.body: Pectins are not absorbed unchanged; they are largely fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E440.prod: Pectin is obtained from fruit peel by acid extraction; amidated pectin is further modified by a chemical process.
t.E440.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern for the general population.
t.E440.regx.1: Purity criteria updated (heavy metal limits lowered); applicable from 18.08.2026.
t.E440.summary: A natural fibre found in the cell walls of fruits (especially apple and citrus peel). It forms a gel in jams, marmalades, jellies and fruit yoghurts.
t.E440.what: It forms a gel and thickens.
